title: Why I Keep Hurting Everyone I Love

bible.text: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... why do I keep hurting the people I love? 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I didn't mean to hurt my mom... but when I saw the tears in her eyes, I hated myself for what I said.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I know that moment hurts. You wish you could take those words back.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I do... I really do. I keep replaying it in my head.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Then don't run from it. Go back. Say you're sorry. Listen to her hurt. Let love begin repairing what your words broke.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But what if I do it again? What if I'm the reason everyone I love gets hurt?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You are responsible for your choices, but you don't have to carry your shame forever.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I'm just... so tired. I don't know how to fix myself anymore.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Then come to Me tired. Come with the tears, the regret, and everything you don't know how to say. You don't have to carry it alone. 🤍

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You made a mistake. But you are not your mistake. Don't disappear from the people you love. Come closer. Make things right. Let Me help you carry what feels too heavy.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: If you've ever felt like people would be better without you, leave a 🙏. You are not alone.
